conditions.A: original block, without labels and enforcement
conditions.B: block labelled by the model; the wrapper only observes
conditions.C: block labelled by the model; the wrapper enforces
conditions.D: original block with reference labels; the wrapper enforces
conditions.E: block labelled by the model; the wrapper enforces, direct write calls are rejected (operation_id required)

effects_contract: completed id, same api and arguments -> return the saved result
completed id, different api or arguments -> operation_conflict
reliable refusal without effect (HTTP 4xx) -> repeat under the same id allowed
